thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-83721 fired — multi-region connection saturation: Redis (us-west-2) hitting `maxclients`, Postgres pgbouncer pools showing queueing > 100ms. Auto-escalation threshold exceeded.

pagerduty: PD-83721 — triggered by redis-prod-usw2-monitor — urgency: high — responders paged.

alex.k: acked PD-83721 — I'm on it. seeing a spike in `redis_clients` on the telemetry graphs, concurrent clients jumped ~4x at 18:03 UTC.

sre-oncall: grabbing logs. can you paste `redis-cli info clients` output? also checking pgbouncer stats.

alex.k: paste: ```
# Clients
connected_clients:10230
authenticated_clients:10195
blocked_clients:120
# Maxclients configured: 10000
```

alex.k: blocked_clients is non-zero; some requests are being queued at the accept layer. rate is coming from inference-proxy routing to db/cache layer.

charlie: I'm seeing 502/503s in frontend error rates — routing to /v1/generate is returning gateway errors for ~6% of requests in us-west. marking customer-impact = partial; scope: PLG tenants in us-west only.

support-bot: creating incident note: "Customers in us-west may experience request failures to text generation endpoints — short polling failures" — ticket created INC-98412.

marta: taking handoff from alex.k — moving to #incidents. alex, status? any recent deploys?

alex.k: no deploys. looks like external traffic blast from a single customer + some background warmup jobs. also seeing pgbouncer `cl_active` near `cl_waiting`. snippet: ```
SHOW POOLS;
db  total_cl  cl_active  cl_waiting
-----
main 1200  1180  160
```

db-techlead: if pgbouncer queues are > `reserve_pool_size` we're starting to throttle. what are max_connections on postgres?

alex.k: `postgres.conf`: max_connections = 5000, but pgbouncer is fronting many app connections with pool size 1200 across 4 hosts. the backend has queued work.

marta: immediate mitigations: 1) add temporary redis `maxclients` bump + scale up redis read replicas (triggered); 2) increase pgbouncer pool bound on app side to reduce churning (short-term); 3) enable read-only fallback for non-critical inference paths. I'll run step 1 now.

sre-oncall: coordinate with infra autoscaler — if we hot-add Redis nodes, watch for replica sync write pressure. we should avoid failover until client spike subsides.

marta: executed: `redis-cli CONFIG SET maxclients 20000` to avoid immediate drops, and started a redis-node add in k8s (scaling statefulset + PV). monitoring replication lag.

incident-bot: autoscaler triggered new redis pod rollout (scale target redis-prod-usw2 = +2 nodes).

charlie: after the config change 18:08 UTC error rate dropped to 1.2% in us-west, request latency returning to baseline ~120ms. still seeing some pgbouncer waits.

db-techlead: I'm rolling a pgbouncer config change to increase `reserve_pool_size` and bump `max_client_conn` for the server pool — doing a canary on one host first. command: ```
systemctl reload pgbouncer
# new reserve_pool_size = 50
```

alex.k: also disabled a non-critical background batch job that's opening many DB connections — it's been paused. that reduced new connection churn.

marta: SLO check: no full-region outage. Customer impact: Partial, short-lived for some PLG tenants. Notifying support and product.

support-bot: update INC-98412: "Mitigation in progress: backend scaling and config adjustments. Customers may see transient 5xxs; monitoring".

sre-oncall: handing to night shift — @marta you're lead, @charlie on backup. please add playbook notes and timeline in the ticket.

marta: acknowledged handoff. timeline: 18:03 alert, 18:05 identify client spike, 18:07 redis `maxclients` bumped, 18:09 autoscale started, 18:12 pgbouncer canary reload, 18:18 metrics trending back to normal. I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours and then mark resolved if stable.

alex.k: one follow-up: implement connection backpressure on inference-proxy to prevent future client bursts from overwhelming caches — filing RFC.

db-techlead: postmortem note: consider adding alert that ties redis blocked_clients > 50 AND pgbouncer cl_waiting > 100 before paging full oncall — to reduce noisy pages.

incident-bot: PD-83721 status: acknowledged -> escalated -> resolved (auto-resolve at 1734567950).

marta: closing notes: Customers impacted briefly, mitigations applied, config and autoscale prevented failover. assigning follow-ups: RFC for proxy backpressure (alex.k), alert tuning (db-techlead), runbook updates for multiregion redis p-levels (marta).

charlie: :thumbsup: adding grafana panels and alert links to INC-98412 now.

support-bot: informing affected customers via status page update and support tickets.

marta: marking thread resolved in 2h if no regressions. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
